_comment: Written by tools/alias_callee_name_drift.py (lane W16-TV). Per placed alias group: the retail callee addresses its survivor reaches in <= `depth` relocation steps, and the membership_verdict of each folded member when recorded. `callee_names` holds the applied map name at each address (null = unnamed). The build's --check re-proves a group when any of those names changes. Do not edit by hand: run --reprove --write on a built tree.
